rows.row: - [ ] Keep `UNKNOWN` as a valid result.
- [ ] Formalize `F(theta)` and distinguish optimal from reachable frontiers.
- [ ] Prove finite base-regime crossover laws under memory/compute/communication/verifier repricing.
- [ ] Derive sufficient conditions for morphology transition, coexistence, hysteresis, and path dependence.
- [ ] Freeze transition predictions before running search.
- [ ] Prospectively predict held-out transitions under grammar/search remints.
- [ ] Replicate with independent search procedures and later real systems.
- [ ] Define novelty relative to transformation closure, not architecture-name distance.
- [ ] A candidate is not novel merely because syntax is unfamiliar; require a mechanism class outside registered known closure under the declared transform budget.
- [ ] Define `UNKNOWN` regions and nearest-known directed burdens.
- [ ] Search for low-cost holes / disconnected reachable regions after known-form recovery is calibrated.
- [ ] Freeze unknown-form criteria before candidate generation.
- [ ] Require stronger-parent refusal, matched simulator baselines, and transfer to disjoint ecology families.
- [ ] Never infer ontological completeness from absence of discovered unknown forms.
- [ ] Work in small dependency-ordered tranches.
- [ ] Freeze theorem target before implementation/evidence.
- [ ] Run exact + hostile checks before PR.
- [ ] Merge a tranche to `main` only when its stated claim ceiling is GREEN.
- [ ] Re-read fresh `main` after every merge before starting the successor.
- [ ] New assumptions/counterexamples create descendant gaps rather than being hidden.

- [ ] Repeat until all registered MTG gaps are either positively closed at their required evidence level or explicitly terminal as impossible/non-identifiable/open; **never force a positive terminal**.
